title: Sticky Date Pudding with Caramel Sauce
description: Microwave marvel — rich, sticky, and surprisingly fast.

method.instruction: Lightly grease a 2L microwave-safe glass bowl and set aside.
Shred the carrot and apple using a slicer or grater.
Place dates and boiling water in a saucepan, bring to a boil, then stir in bicarbonate of soda. Set aside to cool.
In a large bowl, cream butter and both sugars with an electric mixer on medium speed for about 3 minutes until light and fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating for 2 minutes after each addition.
Fold in the cooled shredded carrot, apple, date mixture, sifted flour, and cinnamon. Mix just until combined — do not overmix.
Pour batter into the prepared bowl, cover with plastic wrap (leaving a small vent), and microwave on Medium High (650W) for 10-13 minutes.
Let stand for 5 minutes after cooking. The pudding will continue to set during this time.
For the caramel sauce: Combine brown sugar, butter, cream, and orange liqueur (if using) in a microwave-safe bowl.
Cook on High for 5 minutes, stirring every minute to prevent burning.
Let the sauce stand for a few minutes to thicken before serving.
Turn the pudding out onto a serving plate. Dust with icing sugar.
Drench generously with warm caramel sauce and serve with thickened cream on the side.

notes.title: Microwave Power
notes.content: This recipe was tested in an 800W microwave. Adjust cooking time for different wattages: lower power = longer time, higher power = shorter time.

notes.title: Resting is Essential
notes.content: The 5-minute rest after cooking ensures a moist, tender pudding. Don't skip this step!

notes.title: Watch Carefully
notes.content: Overcooking will dry out the pudding. Check at 10 minutes and add time in 1-minute increments if needed.

notes.title: Serving Suggestion
notes.content: Best served warm with the caramel sauce poured over generously and a dollop of whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.
